statement.zh: **事件**：Logjam 攻击（Logjam Attack）。2015 年，研究团队公开 Logjam 攻击：大量 TLS 服务器使用 512 位或更弱的 Diffie-Hellman 导出级参数，攻击者可预计算离散对数并降级握手。它暴露了“协议正确但参数太弱”的系统性风险。
statement.en: **Event**: Logjam Attack.It is registered under protocols and PKI, dated 2015.

statement.en: It is listed because it connects concrete records, objects or procedures in protocols and PKI, not because of its name.
